About

Who We Are

A sanctuary
of creativity.

At Nomadic London, we believe that great hair is more than just a style — it's a statement of individuality. Nestled in the heart of The Pearl, Qatar, our salon is a sanctuary of creativity, expertise, and personalised care.

Our team of skilled international stylists is dedicated to delivering hair excellence, combining artistry with precision to craft looks that reflect your personality and lifestyle.

Whether you're seeking a bold transformation, a timeless refresh, or a bespoke treatment tailored to your hair's unique needs, we're here to bring your vision to life.

Experience the luxury of expert haircare in an environment designed for you. Welcome to Nomadic London.

Meet the
Staff

Senior Stylist

Chisomo

Colour Specialist

Chisomo brings a wealth of experience and a genuine passion for her craft to the Nomadic chair. Known for her warm energy and meticulous attention to detail, she has built a loyal clientele who trust her with their hair and keep coming back.

Senior Stylist

Jennifer

Curl & Texture Expert

Jennifer's understanding of hair goes beyond technique — she listens, she observes, and she crafts. Her approach is always deeply personal, ensuring every client feels seen and leaves with a result that genuinely reflects who they are.

Stylist

Lizelle

Precision Cutting

Lizelle's eye for detail and commitment to excellence shows in every client she touches. With a calm, confident presence and a precision-led approach, she brings out the best in every look — whether it's a subtle refresh or a complete transformation.

Stylist

Nadia

Vivid Colour & Extensions

Nadia's speciality lies in the bold and the expressive. From saturated vivids to pastel fades, she pushes colour further than most dare — always with calculated care for hair integrity. She also holds advanced certification in hair extension placement and blending.
